edit.description: Add fanout-wave test with mixed noCommit causes across entries, per engineering.md 'A green verdict is proven non-vacuous'.

summary: Test the wave-level noCommit precedence (Dispatcher.ts:1836-1853) across mixed per-entry causes in one wave

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

tests.asserts: a fanout wave with entries failing via ≥2 different noCommit causes (e.g. voluntary-bail + platform-preempt, or voluntary-bail + gate-revert) resolves waveNoCommit per the documented precedence gate-revert > render-refused > platform-preempt > voluntary-bail

acceptance: New test constructs a mixed-cause fanout wave and asserts TickOutcome.noCommit matches the precedence order; fails on a pre-fix tree if the precedence branches at Dispatcher.ts:1844-1852 were reordered or dropped
notes: Every existing test drives one noCommit mode per wave in isolation; superviseLoop:3007-3013 reads this wave label to classify erroredTicks, and voluntary-bail is the one mode explicitly excluded — an inverted precedence would silently drop a real platform/gate failure from the run summary.
